title: Kid Albert's Jazz Band and his nicknames
summary: Interviewers show an old card for Kid Albert's Jazz Band; he explains he was called Tom Albert, Kid Albert, and played cornet.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Um, what was the first band you played with? What was the name of it? Do you remember?
Well, uh, it was your own band or? Yeah, it was my old Tom Albersman. Yeah, they called me Tom Albersman, yeah.
I wonder, uh, Tom, uh, got a card that first came.
Yeah, Ralph, uh, Ralph got this card, an old card of yours from, uh, Professor Mineta. Yeah. It has a picture of a short carnet on it.

Yeah, it has a kind of carnet. And I wonder, it says, Kid Albert's Jazz Band. Kid Albert, yeah. Well, yeah. Let's see, where were you living then? That was on, um... Uh, 28th, what's that? 2610? Uptown, 8th Street.
2610 8th Street then. Yeah. Uptown, number there.
So when was that about? Do you know?

Oh, now, partner. Was that before the First World War, after the war? Kid Albert, and Kid Albert Band. Music, funny for occasion, yeah. Tom Albert, you see? Tom Albert, they called me Tom Albert, but he...and Thomas Albert too, you see that? Yeah.
They also called him Kid Albert.
Yeah, well, when I was in the band, I was called Kid Albert. Kid Albert.
Oh, yeah. Really a carnet, I guess.
